fields.name: unused_head
fields.meaning: Not used; stays zero
fields.evidence: zero in every save image; the format routine starts writing at 0x10

fields.name: signature
fields.meaning: Text '- Shaman King !-' copied from the start of the game program; checked at power-on, and the whole save area is wiped and re-formatted if it does not match
fields.evidence: code 4000:0010 (check; first boot reads), 4000:0867 (power-on: check else format 4000:003e); differs blank vs formatted

fields.name: slots
fields.meaning: Two save slots (record 1, record 2) of 0x99C bytes: slot 1 at 0x0020, slot 2 at 0x09BC. Each is 0x998 bytes of data, 2 pad bytes, then its 16-bit check value. Rows below give slot 1 offsets; add 0x099C for slot 2
fields.evidence: code 4000:01ea (writer, slot bases 0x20/0x9bc), 4000:0286 (loader); diffs of saves to slot 1 vs slot 2

fields.name: save_no
fields.meaning: Save number shown as the small digit at the lower right of the slot in the save/load list; taken from the running save counter each time you save
fields.evidence: code 4000:01d1-01da (counter+1, low byte stored); diff 1/2/3/4 across four saves; shown on slot-list screenshots

fields.name: scene
fields.meaning: Story scene number 1-44; selects the slot-list title from the game's scene-title table (entry 1 = chapter 1 'first battle'); set by the story script
fields.evidence: code 4000:838e (script setter); value 1 matches the slot-list screenshot; ROM table entries 1-44 plus an out-of-range fallback entry; only scene 1 reached in saves so far

fields.name: hdr_flags
fields.meaning: Unknown flags; bits are OR-accumulated during play and the word is read by menu code
fields.evidence: code 4000:8734 (OR into it), reads at 4000:860e/86b8/c593 and 5000:b0b7; zero in every save

fields.name: hdr_script
fields.meaning: Unknown script-set value (script argument lands in its high byte); menu/display code tests it for zero to pick alternate graphics
fields.evidence: code 4000:83b4 (setter), tests at 4000:90fc/9331/9380/950a; zero in every save

fields.name: carryover_flag
fields.meaning: Set to FFFF when the game is finished; then loading the slot offers a new game keeping every ability except special moves. Reset to 0 when the slot is loaded
fields.evidence: code 5000:a914 (set FFFF for finished slot) + 4000:060c (stored to slot), readers 4000:05d0/5000:0db4, load resets, in-game message text; FFFF state never captured in a save

fields.name: members
fields.meaning: Characters who have joined, by character id (1 = Yoh), kept sorted; FF = free entry
fields.evidence: code 4000:7856 (adds id into first free entry), 4000:7dc0 (sort), new game fills FF; diff (01 FF FF FF FF FF)

fields.name: members_pad
fields.meaning: Filler after the member list; FF from a new game
fields.evidence: code 4000:8852-8862 (new game writes FF); member code scans only the 6 bytes above

fields.name: unknown_hdr_12
fields.meaning: Unknown; zero in every save seen; no readers found
fields.evidence: diffs

fields.name: event_counter
fields.meaning: Event counter: raised by 1 by a map tile event, capped at 999; purpose (steps? pickups?) unknown
fields.evidence: code 4000:3ff0-range init 0 at new game, 4000:4a39-4a45 (++ with clamp at 999); zero in every save

fields.name: collection
fields.meaning: A 22-entry collection of obtained ids, 0x00FF = empty; low byte holds id plus an 0x80 flag (compared masked to 7 bits), high byte unknown. Linked to the per-character slot at record +0x34; the KIND collected is unknown (all empty so far)
fields.evidence: code: find 4000:7ca6, remove+compact 4000:7b04, count 4000:cc6c, owner lookup 4000:7c60, per-member check 4000:d180; new-game fill 00FF

fields.name: party
fields.meaning: Four party positions of 0x5C bytes, each a copy of a character record (layout as the roster rows below). A slot counts as used when a position id byte is outside {0,FF}. Rebuilt from the roster before every save
fields.evidence: code 4000:0512 (used test), 4000:04c6 (slot list), 4000:ca9a (rebuild from flagged roster records), 4000:8b76 (clear + rebuild before save); diff position 1 = Yoh's record

fields.name: roster
fields.meaning: Seven character records of 0x5C bytes (characters 1-7, Yoh first). At scene 1 they still equal the built-in starting table
fields.evidence: code 4000:880b (new game copies ROM table to RAM), 4000:0306 (carry-over walks 7 records); save matches ROM table byte for byte

fields.name: roster[n].number
fields.meaning: Character number 1-7 (record n at slot+0x1B4+n*0x5C)
fields.evidence: diffs (1..7 in order); ROM table

fields.name: roster[n].id
fields.meaning: Character id used by the member list and slot portraits (Yoh = 1; others 3,5,7,9,0B,0C); FF marks an empty party position
fields.evidence: code 4000:7856 (stored into member list), 4000:04c6/0512 (FF = empty); diffs

fields.name: roster[n].flags
fields.meaning: Bit 0x80 = character is in the active party (Yoh set, others clear); other bits unknown
fields.evidence: code 4000:ca9a (tests bit 0x80 to rebuild party); diffs

fields.name: roster[n].element
fields.meaning: Main element: 0 wood, 1 fire, 2 earth, 3 metal, 4 water (Yoh = 0, shown as wood)
fields.evidence: status screenshot (Yoh: wood) and element order shown there; diffs

fields.name: roster[n].smp
fields.meaning: SMP (power points) shown on map and menu; Yoh = 270
fields.evidence: status and map screenshots (270 = 0x010E)

fields.name: roster[n].unknown_06
fields.meaning: Unknown; 0 for all characters; read together with SMP by map-event code
fields.evidence: code 4000:4985 (read paired with SMP); diffs

fields.name: roster[n].waza
fields.meaning: Technique stat; Yoh = 70
fields.evidence: status screenshot (70)

fields.name: roster[n].tai
fields.meaning: Body stat; Yoh = 60
fields.evidence: status screenshot (60)

fields.name: roster[n].kokoro
fields.meaning: Mind stat; Yoh = 85
fields.evidence: status screenshot (85)

fields.name: roster[n].gp
fields.meaning: Guardian-spirit GP (Yoh's spirit); Yoh = 410
fields.evidence: status screenshot (410)

fields.name: roster[n].class
fields.meaning: Shaman class (Yoh = 9, shown as rank 8; others 8); exact value-to-rank mapping unknown
fields.evidence: status screenshot (rank 8 for value 9)

fields.name: roster[n].element_levels
fields.meaning: Element levels wood/fire/earth/metal/water, signed; Yoh = 1,-3,0,-3,-3
fields.evidence: status screenshot

fields.name: roster[n].base_copy
fields.meaning: Second copy of +0x04..+0x1B (SMP, stats, GP, class, element levels); equal to the first copy in every record seen, probably base values before equipment or effects
fields.evidence: diffs (identical copies in all 7 records); carry-over skips the same GP/class words in both copies

fields.name: roster[n].collect_id
fields.meaning: Collection id linked to the 22-entry list (FF = none); the game finds a character by it and looks it up in the list
fields.evidence: code 4000:7c60 (find owner), 4000:d180 (per-member list lookup); FF in every record seen

fields.name: roster[n].skill_count
fields.meaning: Number of special-move ids in the list below (5 or 6)
fields.evidence: diffs (count matches ids before FFFF padding in every record); carry-over load skips this area

fields.name: roster[n].skills
fields.meaning: Special-move ids (a word each), FFFF = empty; dropped when carrying over into a new game
fields.evidence: diffs; code 4000:0306 skips +0x35..+0x55 (matches the carry-over message); name table exists in ROM but its indexing is not mapped

fields.name: roster[n].unknown_56
fields.meaning: Unknown; 5 for every character; kept on carry-over
fields.evidence: diffs; code 4000:0306 keeps it

fields.name: roster[n].unknown_57
fields.meaning: Unknown; zero
fields.evidence: diffs

fields.name: roster[n].coord
fields.meaning: Map/object coordinate pair consumed by the map setup code; zero in every save
fields.evidence: code 4000:4685/468e (copied into map position variables); diffs

fields.name: world_state
fields.meaning: Script/global state variables other than characters; mostly zero at scene 1 (a few nonzero cells, see sub-rows). Not restored by a carry-over load
fields.evidence: code 4000:0255/02cf (saved/loaded as one block), 4000:0306 skips it; diffs

fields.name: world.e88_script
fields.meaning: Script counter cell (raised/lowered/tested against small constants by story-script code)

fields.name: world.e99_script
fields.meaning: Script value cell (set to 0/3/31 by init/script code, read into script arithmetic)

fields.name: world.eda_cleared_flags
fields.meaning: Cleared-game copy of the place flags, stamped at carry-over load and tested by place-flag checks
fields.evidence: code 4000:046a (stamp from place flags), 4000:5040/47d4 (tests)

fields.name: hdr_copy
fields.meaning: Second copy of slot bytes +0x00..+0x17 (the saved RAM block runs on into the header area); always equal to them
fields.evidence: code 4000:0255 (block overlaps); diffs (save number changes in both places)

fields.name: map
fields.meaning: Current map/area number (1 in the saves seen); set by the story script
fields.evidence: code 5000:992d (script setter), 4000:3fbf (start value 1), 4000:443e (indexes the map data table); diffs

fields.name: leader_id
fields.meaning: Map leader character id selecting the walking sprite (1 = Yoh)
fields.evidence: code 4000:4284 (scans roster for the id), 4000:42eb/43d8 (passed to sprite code), 4000:3fc4 (start value 1); only 1 seen

fields.name: leader_hi
fields.meaning: High byte of the above; never written, always 0
fields.evidence: code writes only the low byte; diffs

fields.name: pos_x
fields.meaning: Player position on the map, horizontal (range 0x18-0xE8)
fields.evidence: diffs (moves with walking: 0x27->0x2A, 0x27->0x66); code 4000:436c-4391 (D-pad, bounds), 5000:9943 (script warp)

fields.name: pos_y
fields.meaning: Player position on the map, vertical (range 0x18-0x5C)
fields.evidence: diffs (0x5C->0x59); code 4000:43a7-43cb (bounds), 5000:9946 (warp)

fields.name: unknown_4c8
fields.meaning: Unknown; zeroed at new game; no other writers found
fields.evidence: code 4000:3fda/3fdf; diffs

fields.name: obj_id
fields.meaning: Current object/leader id stamped from the character record at map setup; read by map-event code
fields.evidence: code 4000:4682 (stamp), 4000:49b5/49c9/49dd (reads); 0 in saves

fields.name: obj_slot
fields.meaning: Map object-table slot index (selects an 8-byte entry); 0 in saves
fields.evidence: code 4000:466d/48a9/4f29 (index arithmetic); diffs

fields.name: place_flags
fields.meaning: Bit flags (one per place/event), set by the story script; copied to the cleared-game cell on carry-over
fields.evidence: code 4000:50ac (OR-set by script), 4000:5040 (test/set with map-marker updates), 4000:3fe4 (start 0), 4000:046a (carry-over copy); 0 in saves

fields.name: map_event_flags
fields.meaning: Map event flags: bit 7 = fresh-map marker (set at new game, cleared on first event check); bits 0-4 OR-set by map events (all five set unlocks a bonus path)
fields.evidence: code 4000:3fea (start 0x80), 4000:4621/478f (test bit 7), 4000:4797 (clear), 4000:4b07 (set bits 0-4), 4000:4b1d (all-five test); 0x80 in saves

fields.name: flags_area
fields.meaning: Story/event flags area; all zero at scene 1. Carried over into a new game
fields.evidence: code 4000:026d (save), 4000:02e7 (load), 4000:045e (carry-over); diffs all zero

fields.name: slot_pad
fields.meaning: Not written by the save routine; stays FF
fields.evidence: code 4000:01ea copies 0x998 bytes only; diffs

fields.name: slot_check
fields.meaning: Check value of the slot: for the 0x4CD little-endian words w[i] of the slot data, sum of (w[i] + i) mod 0x10000. A slot whose check fails is erased at power-on
fields.evidence: code 4000:01a2 (algorithm), 4000:012e (store), 5000:0c0a-0c25 (power-on: check, erase bad slot); recomputed over every save image, 0 mismatches

fields.name: total_check
fields.meaning: Check value over both slots including their check values (0x0020-0x1357, 0x99C words), same algorithm; mismatch at power-on is detected
fields.evidence: code 4000:0196/012e (store), 4000:00e2 (verify), 5000:0c2c (power-on); recomputed over every save image, 0 mismatches

fields.name: counters
fields.meaning: 200 one-byte script-event counters kept outside the save slots (saved immediately, shared by both slots, not covered by any check value): a script call adds 1, another branches on zero/nonzero. All zero in the saves seen; per-counter meanings unknown
fields.evidence: code 4000:8396 (+1 and write back), 4000:0482/04a4 (save/load block), 5000:b654 (loaded at power-on), 5000:bc04 (branch reader), 4000:0076 (format: zero); diffs

fields.name: save_counter
fields.meaning: Running count of saves made on this cartridge (both slots); its low byte becomes the slot's save number
fields.evidence: code 4000:01d1 (+1 on every save), 4000:0091 (format: 0); diffs 1/2/3/4

fields.name: unused_ff
fields.meaning: Filled with FF when the cartridge memory is formatted; no other use found
fields.evidence: code 4000:006b (format fills 0x20-0x1CF3 with FF); diffs

fields.name: unused_tail
fields.meaning: Not used; stays zero
fields.evidence: diffs (0 in every image)

fields.name: not_used
fields.meaning: The console's internal EEPROM is not used by this game's saves
fields.evidence: byte-identical in every save image
